data.name: 3AM
data.detailed_description:
We currently live in a dystopian world where we share space with AI replicating the human experience -- which is creating art. Art comes for your experiences on earth, trauma, love, emotions, vulnerability, your sense of self. Art is one of the very things that keeps humans alive.

The 3AM (3D Art Museum) is an immersive POV experience where you walk through an art museum filled with thousands of artists against AI. The art museum looks like a typical museum but starts to blur the lines between what's real and reality. Who is behind creating the museum and what are its intentions? who knows?

You'll be able to walk around and interact going through different themed rooms. You'll first spawn and be surrounded in hundreds of art in the main lobby. Some themed rooms have elements of liminal space/dreamcore. Some rooms are peaceful where you can sit on a bench and appreciate all of the art you're surrounded in. I hope this experience makes visitors slow down and become mindful instead of the instant gratification of social media. 

There will be some activities while you go on this adventure -- whether it's spray painting on graffiti walls, finding hidden passageways, or puzzles that you need a physical object to complete. The art museum is neverending and also a timestamp of all of us artists coming together in this moment. Maybe we can look back on this in 30 years from now and think, wow we did that?? 

Disclaimer: I am not a game developer. I'm just an artist making a space for artists. So if the game breaks and you're stuck at the edge of the universe hanging on the the edge, I am so sorry orz

My plan is to release the themed rooms in segments. It might take me a while since it's mostly a thing I'm going to be doing after work.
